archiver 2.4.1
Packs and unpacks archives

USAGE:
    archiver [FLAGS] [OPTIONS] <SUBCOMMAND>

FLAGS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information
    -q, --quiet      Suppress output
    -V, --version    Prints version information

OPTIONS:
    -l, --level <level>          Compression level [default: 6]  [possible values: fast, normal, best]
    -o, --output-dir <output>    Where to write results

SUBCOMMANDS:
    pack      Create an archive
    unpack    Extract an archive
    list      List archive contents
    help      Prints this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
